name: Web of Mortal Bonds
description: Relationships form between mortals. Weave a living web of obligation and kinship.

prose.setup_to_escalation: Four mortal hearts find each other. Relationships weave themselves into being. A web of living bonds begins to hum.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: Eight bonds now link the mortals together. The web grows dense and resilient. Kinship becomes something you can almost touch.
prose.completed: Twelve threads bind mortals in an intricate web of relation. Oaths, loyalties, and affections hold. The pattern is complete.
prose.failed: The bonds fray. Hearts turn away from one another. No web can hold if mortals refuse each other.
